import os
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in __import__('re').finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
P='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0-u1-turns/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u088/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(P,exist_ok=True)
demo1_in=G['Demo pair 1 input']; demo1_out=G['Demo pair 1 output']
demo2_in=G['Demo pair 2 input']; demo2_out=G['Demo pair 2 output']

def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # marker: row or column of non-bg, non-shape color (color appearing as a full line at edge)
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    marker=max((n,col) for col,n in c.items() if n in (H,W) or n>=min(H,W) and n< c[max(c,key=c.get)] )  # fallback unused
    # simpler: find the color forming a complete line
    full=[col for col in c if any(all(g[i][j]==col for j in range(W)) for i in range(H)) or any(all(g[i][j]==col for j in [0]) and all(g[i][k]==col for k in range(W)) for i in [0])]
    lines=[col for col in c if any(sum(1 for x in row if x==col)==W for row in g) or any(sum(1 for r in g if r[j]==col)==H for j in range(W))]
    lines=[col for col in lines if col!=0]
    marker=lines[0]
    shape=max(c,key=lambda k:c[k]) if c[marker]<max(c.values()) else None
    # shape = second most common color that isn't marker or 0
    order=[k for k,_ in sorted(c.items(),key=lambda kv:-kv[1]) if k!=marker and k!=0]
    shape=order[0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==shape]
    rs=[i for i,j in cells]; cs=[j for i,j in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    # is marker a row or a column?
    if any(all(g[i][j]==marker for j in range(W)) for i in range(H)):  # horizontal marker row
        mrow=[i for i in range(H) if all(g[i][j]==marker for j in range(W))][0]
        side = 1 if mrow>r1 else -1
        cand = r1+1 if side==1 else r0-1
        if not (0<=cand<H and all(g[cand][j]!=marker for j in range(W))):
            cand = r0-1 if side==1 else r1+1
        for j in range(W): g[cand][j]=8
    else:
        mcol=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==marker for i in range(H))][0]
        side = 1 if mcol>c1 else -1
        cand = c1+1 if side==1 else c0-1
        if not (0<=cand<W and all(g[i][cand]!=marker for i in range(H))):
            cand = c0-1 if side==1 else c1+1

    r0,r1=min(i for i,j in cells),max(i for i,j in cells)
